description: Exploratory rebuild of the PR #7 baseline with mapping v2 (decision 0003). The primary baseline uses baseline_config.json and mapping v1.

stratum_support.rule: metrics for a stratum only with at least min_R resistant and min_S susceptible metric-eligible endpoints; smaller strata keep counts with NA metrics
stratum_support.basis: same 10 R / 10 S floor as per-country reporting in decision 0001

temporal.basis: periods from decision 0001 (earlier before 2021, recent from 2021); calendar years are reported as counts with the same support rule

mapping_audit.action: flag for human review only; no rule is changed on observed agreement
